usage: Test-only fixture builders take the literal names a test is about (flag names, manifest IDs, paths, locale tags, catalogue text) as &str parameters. That is the point of a fixture helper, so the production-code heuristic for string-heavy signatures is not applied to them. Every other rule keeps its default weight on these files.
